name: Transports Metropolitans de Barcelona (TMB)

healthCheck.reason: Disabled to avoid false failures, credentials, or large downloads.

notes: Official TMB GTFS requires developer credentials for direct access.
Travel2U should use a server-side/build-time credential, never embed a TMB secret in a public Android APK.
Realtime is available through TMB developer services but is not enabled in the bootstrap until credentials and exact endpoints are configured.
